design: Append-only immutable revision states and exclusive per-revision claim; fsync/readback, then same-directory os.replace of a new pending head. Orphan/incomplete artifacts stop reopening without repair.
guarantees: At-most-once reservation/consumption in the tested model. Never exactly-once server delivery. A crash after a claim burns the slot or requires manual review; it is never automatically refunded.
trust: Hashes are not signatures. A separately trusted head anchor and an effective ownership boundary are required against same-user rewriting/rehashing.
verification_results: Final measured test counts and private JUnit hashes are recorded in VALIDATION.json after execution.
